reason: The neutral description and p. 4 locator do not uniquely identify one critical test: the source reports five task-phase O-score tests, a pooled mixed model of O-score strength, and another mixed model of peak frequency. The supplied study identifier 1,5 may instead refer to constituent experiments; the source identifies experiment 1 as visual and experiment 5 as memory, but directs experiment-specific participant counts to Supplementary Table 1. This table and the numeric Fig. 1C image are not present in the supplied text. Reported group counts precede phase-specific exclusions and are not explicit final groups for an identified critical test. Therefore no analytic N is assigned. Participant counts and repeated participant-by-phase observations must be distinguished; no N is derived from df, recruitment totals, percentages, or subtraction of exclusions.
